_comment: Fleet policy. See docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-03-agent-fleet-orchestrator-design.md. Model ids are NEVER hardcoded - slots resolve from the environment (spec 15.8).

budget._cap_note: UNCALIBRATED. The previous value (2000000) was invented and is ~60x below measured spend (118,306,514 weighted tokens on 2026-10-04). The proxy meter is not readable programmatically, so this cannot be calibrated from evidence - it needs the real figure from the user or the provider dashboard. While null, budgetCheck() is ADVISORY ONLY and never blocks a dispatch.

jev._authority_note: gate = JEV decides when confident AND the state carried raw evidence; every uncertain/unavailable branch escalates to orchestrator review. Never auto-passes on JEV uncertainty (spec 16 ladder). VERIFIED 2026-10-04: 5/5 labelled cases decided correctly, 0 false escalations, after the 14.12b raw-output rule removed the earlier false positive.
jev._outage_evidence: see the operator's private evidence archive (not shipped)

providers.note: fallback, metered - reports usage.cost in USD

jev._providers_note: Both speak the native systemone shape. CORRECTED 2026-10-04: OpenRouter DOES serve JEV, at /api/alpha/decisions - not the chat endpoint. typesafe/jev-router is a different product (a model router) and is NOT usable as a gate.

model_rates._comment: Substring -> USD per 1M tokens, used by `fleet score <run-id>` for the price axis. Longest-key wins so specific ids beat broad ones (e.g. 'claude-opus-5-5' before 'claude'). All entries below are 0 (UNPRICED) until real rates are supplied from the proxy / provider dashboard.
